text_block_list.text:
It's been several days since I began my job
as a trainer, and I'm
itching to recruit a
racer of my own. I'm heading down to the
training
grounds when...
Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: WATCH OOOUT!

Suddenly, the leg of a desk is flying
straight at me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-are you okay? I'm so, so, sooo sorry!

Thanks to the warning, I manage to avoid
a very untimely death... But
that still begs
the question...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? D-desk legs? Fly? Ah... r-r-right!
Wh-wh-what have I doooone?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-wh-what am I going to do NOW?!

Behind her I notice a desk missing one leg.
I do my best to calm down
the panicking
student, and eventually, I'm able to get
the story out of
her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I... I'm pretty much a walking disaster. I
can never do anything right,
but, um...
Well... I-I still want to help when I can...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So when someone told me Opera O's desk
has been w-wobbly
lately... I-I thought I'd
fix it for her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... When I tried to bend it back into
place, the leg broke off
instead! I-I
panicked, and the next thing I knew... the
desk leg flew
out of my hand...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I should've known I would make
a mess of things! And now I
involved an
innocent trainer too... I'm the wooorst!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I need to do something before I cause
any more problems... Think,
think... I know!
I'll just glue the leg back on and then
leave!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
WH-WHYYY?! Why won't you stick to the
desk, leg?! A-and now
everything's all
sticky...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I know... I can secure the leg with rope!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: THAT DIDN'T WORK EITHEEER!
Crack!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyah?! It broke! Wh-wh-what do I do
nooow?!

It's already late... I'm just about to tell her
that she can ask for a
replacement desk
tomorrow, when suddenly I hear a
thunderous
laugh.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what all that ruckus was
about! To think I would come
across such
tragedy! My desk, once as beautiful as me,
is in pieces!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-O-O-Ope...Ope...Opera O?! I-I'm so
sorry! I-I can explain! I was
just—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: EXCELLENT!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My shining desk, lying in disarray... Two of
its legs strewn about the
floor! The
blanket of moonlight draping it in sorrow!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What more could I ask for in a display of
true grief? Behold, Doto! Do
I not shine all
the more against this tragic backdrop?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! You're shining brightly!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! And please, take as many
photographs as you like! You
there! Work
the fan so that I may have a breeze to
flutter my locks!

Before I know it, I'm working behind the
scenes at an impromptu
photoshoot for
T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Excellent shots! Chaos and creation!
Despair and hope! And
towering above it
all stands I, T.M. Opera O... Bravo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've underestimated you, Doto! To
think you had such
passion for stagecraft!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no, I was, uh, ummm...

T.M. Opera O seems completely oblivious
to Doto's anxious
behavior... Beaming with
pride, she nods with satisfaction before

continuing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My eyes have never deceived me before!
Therefore, I have a
proposition for you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: For my next operatic performance at the Tracen Meet to be a success, I want—nay, I NEED your help! Tales of our fierce battle shall spread far and wide!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? B-battle? M-m-m-me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! To you, my dear, I deem a
central role in my saga. You shall
be... the
villain!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: WHAAAT?!
